name: 50th Annual International Seminar on Macroeconomics (ISOM 2027)
organizer: NBER International Seminar on Macroeconomics; hosted by the Central Bank of Montenegro (organizers Jordi Gali and Kenneth West)
submission_requirements: Upload a PDF (detailed abstract or draft paper); papers must not be under review at another journal. Travel expenses covered for one author per paper; only authors of accepted papers are contacted.
journal: Authors agree to let the Journal of International Economics consider papers for a special issue (2027 guest editor Vivian Yue)
